primitives.verbatim_quote: --## TL;DR When the engine publishes a pick, the pipeline auto-generates a 2-to-4-point "What Would Change Our Mind" note.
primitives.assumptions: Each trigger condition C(F, T) is derived from PickSignalSnapshot and maps to a binary outcome.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When F(t) crosses critical threshold, C becomes true, invalidating pick validity.

primitives.name: Conditional Refutation
primitives.verbatim_quote: The note lists the specific conditions that would have to be true for the pick to lose.
primitives.assumptions: Refutation occurs when P(R|C) > threshold, implying M decreases below acceptance level.
primitives.breakdown_regime: At P(R|C) ≥ 0.5, model must re-evaluate pick validity.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to Bayesian evidence accumulation; each bullet acts as a likelihood ratio update.
layer2.telemetry: Probability of refutation given condition, model confidence decay

primitives.name: Template-Based Reasoning
primitives.verbatim_quote: Each bullet ties to a specific factor signal from the pick's `PickSignalSnapshot`.
primitives.assumptions: Each factor F_i has a deterministic template T_i(S) producing bullet B_i.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Template application fails if S lacks required fields for T_i.

reasoning_traces.think:
The pre-mortem pipeline operates as a dual system: one layer generates structured failure hypotheses from pick signals, while another evaluates their impact on model confidence. Each bullet represents a conditional refutation, modeled as a logical trigger C(F, T) where F is the factor signal and T is the temporal window. These triggers are mapped to a Bayesian framework where P(R|C) quantifies risk exposure. The system uses factor-specific templates to ensure consistency and traceability. The failure modes are not arbitrary but grounded in signal dynamics—e.g., rest advantage flipping implies a shift in fatigue projections. The pipeline’s design enforces accountability by committing to weak points before outcomes are known. This mirrors a predictive control loop where pre-mortems act as feedback mechanisms to adjust belief states in real time.
